About.Name: Joey Legge
About.AboutText:
Hi, I am Joey Legge. I am a passionate computer science student with a keen interest in software development and programming. Currently, I am pursuing my undergraduate degree at Seattle Pacific University. I am dedicated to expanding my knowledge and skills in various areas of computer science, with a particular focus on C++ programming.

I enjoy tackling challenging programming projects and I thrive in collaborative environments where I can contribute my expertise and learn from my peers.

Beyond the classroom, I actively engage in extracurricular activities related to computer science, including hackathons, and coding competitions. I believe in the importance of continuous learning and seek out opportunities to explore new technologies and methodologies.

Project1.Title: Exp-Addition To The Old West
Project1.Desc:
This Project was made for the 2026 SPU Hackathon, and it was made by a friend of mine and I over the course of 3 days. We placed second in the competition for our solution to increasing learning retention rates in K through 12 students. We narrowed our scope down to 1st through 3rd and designed a point-and-click adventure math game

It has a GitHub repo and more details shown in screenshots.

Project2.Title: Introduction to Data Science Final
Project2.Desc:
This project was made for my final project in Introduction to Data Science, it was to show a webb launched application for statistics.

It does not have a GitHub repo.

Project3.Title: Texas V.S. Maryland
Project3.Desc:
This is a research paper written by me and a group of peers describing gerrymandering in the U.S. in particular it is about gerrmandering in Texas V.S. in Maryland.

It does have a GitHub repo but since it's a paper it doesn't have any additional screenshots.
